title: A Dog on a Log

scenes.summary: The narrator sits on a beach when a hog notices a dog on a log.
scenes.text: On a beach by a tree, sat my family and me. Then shouted a hog, There's a Dog On A Log.
scenes.image_prompt: family sitting on beach near tree with ocean and a surprised hog pointing, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Everyone wonders why the dog is saving a flea in the water.
scenes.text: A Dog On A Log Well, how can that be He must be saving that big frightening flea. Now why would a dog be saving a flea Especially in the water on the branch of a tree.
scenes.image_prompt: dog standing confused on floating log with small flea nearby in water, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: The flea pulls up a boat and its family escapes from the dog.
scenes.text: I couldn't believe what I saw happen next. Even that Dog On A Log was perplexed. The flea pulled on a rope and up came a boat. I'll bet you can't guess what happened next. A flea family ran from the dog's little toe. They got into the boat and began to row.
scenes.image_prompt: tiny fleas pulling a rope bringing a boat while dog watches surprised on log, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: The flea family reaches shore and heads toward the hog.
scenes.text: Once on the shore, they ran through the sand. Over a cookie in my left hand. Right to the hog that's where they went.
scenes.image_prompt: tiny flea family running on sand toward a pink hog while child holds cookie, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: The fleas find a new home on the hog while the dog and narrator continue their day.
scenes.text: They found a new home with an unpleasant scent. As for the Dog he's still riding that log. As for me Ouch I think I have a flea.
scenes.image_prompt: fleas sitting on a hog while dog floats on log and child scratches head, colorful cartoon children's book style

story: On a beach by a tree, sat my family and me. Then shouted a hog, There's a Dog On A Log. A Dog On A Log Well, how can that be He must be saving that big frightening flea. Now why would a dog be saving a flea Especially in the water on the branch of a tree. I couldn't believe what I saw happen next. Even that Dog On A Log was perplexed. The flea pulled on a rope and up came a boat. I'll bet you can't guess what happened next. A flea family ran from the dog's little toe. They got into the boat and began to row. Once on the shore, they ran through the sand. Over a cookie in my left hand. Right to the hog that's where they went. They found a new home with an unpleasant scent. As for the Dog he's still riding that log. As for me Ouch I think I have a flea.
